_PROVENANCE.purpose: Improve REAL turbidity retrieval from Sentinel-2 optics vs the HydroViT station-holdout baseline (Turb R2=-0.0054).
_PROVENANCE.data_description: REAL Sentinel-2 L2A (B02,B03,B04,B08) paired with REAL same-day in-situ USGS turbidity (NTU).
_PROVENANCE.split: STATION (site_id) GroupKFold — no site shared train/test.
_PROVENANCE.ci: site-clustered bootstrap (resamples sites, not rows), 2000 reps.
_PROVENANCE.target_fix: log1p(NTU) stabilises the heavy tail (p99=112, max=953 NTU); predictions back-transformed to NTU for an honest original-scale R2.

diagnosis.why_baseline_near_zero: Raw-NTU R2 is dominated by a few extreme (>>100 NTU) spikes; squared error on the heavy tail swamps skill on the bulk. A log-target + spectral turbidity indices recover held-out skill.

raw_target_original_scale.note: GBM on raw NTU; reproduces the near-zero R2 pathology of the baseline.

log_target_log_scale.note: R2 on log1p(NTU) — the scale the model optimises.

log_target_original_scale.note: log-target predictions back-transformed to NTU; honest apples-to-apples vs the -0.0054 baseline.
